items.claim: When `signer=None` is passed, `Serializer.__init__` uses the class default signer, which for the plain serializer is `Signer`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__init__` replaces a `None` signer with `self.default_signer`, which is set to `Signer` on the base `Serializer` class.

items.claim: Fallback signer configurations may be a dict of signer kwargs, a tuple of (signer_class, kwargs), or a signer class.
items.label: supported
items.reason: iter_unsigners explicitly handles a dict of kwargs, a (signer, kwargs) tuple, or a bare Signer class.

items.claim: `bytes_to_int()` right-justifies the input to 8 bytes with `rjust(8, b'\x00')` before unpacking with `_int64_struct.unpack()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: bytes_to_int calls _bytes_to_int (the Struct '>Q' unpack) on bytestr.rjust(8, b'\x00').

items.claim: `Signer.verify_signature` calls `want_bytes` on the value before comparison.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `verify_signature` runs `value = want_bytes(value)` before the key-derivation/comparison loop.

items.claim: In `Serializer`, the newest secret key is used for signing while all keys are tried during verification.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Serializer stores keys oldest-to-newest with the last used for signing, and verify_signature tries every key.

items.claim: `BadSignature` has a `payload` attribute defined in exc.py.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `BadSignature.__init__` sets `self.payload` in exc.py.

items.claim: The payload attached to the `BadSignature` raised by `Signer.unsign` is the raw, still-base64, undeserialised value.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `unsign` splits off the signature and attaches the untouched pre-separator value (the still-encoded, not-yet-deserialized payload) to `BadSignature`.

items.claim: `URLSafeTimedSerializer.loads()` raises `SignatureExpired` when the token is older than `max_age`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: URLSafeTimedSerializer inherits TimedSerializer.loads, which propagates SignatureExpired raised by TimestampSigner.unsign on max_age.

items.claim: The tox `docs` environment runs `sphinx-build -E -W -b dirhtml`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The tox docs env command is exactly sphinx-build -E -W -b dirhtml docs docs/_build/dirhtml.

items.claim: `Signer.derive_key` raises `TypeError` for an unknown key derivation method.
items.label: supported
items.reason: derive_key raises TypeError("Unknown key derivation method") in the else branch.

items.claim: `Serializer.__init__` allows `salt=None`, deferring the decision to the `Signer`'s own default.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Salt is only converted when not `None`, with a comment stating the signer's default is used otherwise.

items.claim: `Serializer` uses `Signer`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Serializer.default_signer is Signer and make_signer instantiates it.

items.claim: `BadPayload` descends from `BadData` in exc.py.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `class BadPayload(BadData)` is declared in exc.py.

items.claim: In `Serializer.dumps` the payload is wrapped as `want_bytes(self.dump_payload(obj))`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `dumps` literally computes `payload = want_bytes(self.dump_payload(obj))`.

items.claim: `TimedSerializer.iter_unsigners()` returns an iterator of `TimestampSigner`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: iter_unsigners is typed and cast to cabc.Iterator[TimestampSigner].

items.claim: The GitHub Actions workflow `publish.yaml` is triggered by git tag pushes and contains `build`, `create-release`, and `publish-pypi` jobs.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The workflow triggers on push tags '*' and defines build, create-release, and publish-pypi jobs.

items.claim: `Signer.verify_signature` wraps `base64_decode(sig)` in a bare `try`/`except Exception` that returns `False`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The base64 decode is wrapped in `try/except Exception: return False`.

items.claim: `want_bytes` in encoding.py encodes text as UTF-8 with `errors='strict'`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `want_bytes` defaults to `encoding="utf-8"` and `errors="strict"` when encoding a `str`.

items.claim: `HMACAlgorithm.get_signature` calls `hmac.new(key, msg=value, digestmod=self.digest_method)` and returns `mac.digest()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The method body matches exactly: `hmac.new(key, msg=value, digestmod=self.digest_method)` then `mac.digest()`.

items.claim: `Serializer.iter_unsigners` iterates `self.fallback_signers`, treating a dict entry as kwargs with `self.signer` as the class, a tuple entry as `(class, kwargs)`, and anything else as a signer class with `self.signer_kwargs`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The loop handles dict, tuple, and fallthrough cases exactly as described.

items.claim: `URLSafeSerializer.dumps()` converts Python objects to signed strings.
items.label: supported
items.reason: URLSafeSerializer is a Serializer[str] whose dumps serializes and signs objects, returning a str.

items.claim: The GitHub Actions workflow `tests.yaml` is triggered by pull requests and pushes to main and stable branches.
items.label: supported
items.reason: tests.yaml triggers on pull_request and push to branches [main, stable].

items.claim: `docs/conf.py` defines project links for Donate, PyPI Releases, Source Code, Issue Tracker, and Discord Chat in `html_context["project_links"]`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: html_context['project_links'] lists Donate, PyPI Releases, Source Code, Issue Tracker, and Chat (Discord).

items.claim: `URLSafeTimedSerializer` is a separate class defined in url_safe.py that provides age limits.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `URLSafeTimedSerializer` is defined in url_safe.py mixing in `TimedSerializer`, which supports `max_age`.

items.claim: `Signer.default_digest_method` is `_lazy_sha1`, a function that defers the `hashlib.sha1` attribute access to call time.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `default_digest_method` is `staticmethod(_lazy_sha1)`, and `_lazy_sha1` accesses `hashlib.sha1` only when called.

items.claim: The `django-concat` key derivation computes `digest_method(salt + b"signer" + secret_key).digest()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The django-concat branch returns digest_method(self.salt + b"signer" + secret_key).digest().

items.claim: The GitHub Actions workflow `lock.yaml` runs on a daily schedule and contains a `lock` job.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The repository contains only pre-commit.yaml, publish.yaml, and tests.yaml workflows; no lock.yaml exists.

items.claim: The `hmac` key derivation computes `hmac.new(secret_key, salt, digestmod).digest()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The hmac branch creates hmac.new(secret_key, digestmod=digest_method), updates with salt, and returns digest(), equivalent to the claim.

items.claim: `TestTimestampSigner` contains 8 test methods.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: TestTimestampSigner defines 7 test methods (max_age, return_timestamp, timestamp_missing, malformed_timestamp, malformed_future_timestamp, future_age, sig_error_date_signed), not 8.

items.claim: `URLSafeSerializerMixin` comes first in the bases of `URLSafeSerializer`, so the mixin's `load_payload` is used.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `URLSafeSerializer(URLSafeSerializerMixin, Serializer[str])` puts the mixin first, so its `load_payload` wins in the MRO.

items.claim: `Signer.__init__` stores `key_derivation` without validating it.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__init__` just assigns `key_derivation`; the unknown-method `TypeError` is raised later in `derive_key`.

items.claim: The publish workflow's publish-pypi job uses `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` with `packages-dir: artifact/`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: publish-pypi uses pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish with packages-dir: artifact/.

items.claim: `Signer.__init__` converts `sep` with `want_bytes` and raises `ValueError` if `self.sep` is in `_base64_alphabet`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `self.sep = want_bytes(sep)` followed by a `ValueError` if `self.sep in _base64_alphabet`.

items.claim: When `fallback_signers=None` is passed, `Serializer.__init__` sets it to a copy of `default_fallback_signers`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `fallback_signers = list(self.default_fallback_signers)` makes a copy of the class default.

items.claim: `Serializer.loads` calls `unsign` before `load_payload`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `self.load_payload(signer.unsign(s))` evaluates `unsign` first, then loads the payload.

items.claim: The test suite lives in `tests/test_itsdangerous/` and includes `test_signer.py`, `test_serializer.py`, `test_timed.py`, and `test_encoding.py`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: All four named test modules exist under tests/test_itsdangerous/.

items.claim: `docs/conf.py` sets `autodoc_preserve_defaults = True`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: conf.py sets autodoc_preserve_defaults = True.

items.claim: The `gha-update` dependency group contains `gha-update` conditioned on `python_full_version >= "3.12"`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The gha-update group contains "gha-update ; python_full_version >= '3.12'".

items.claim: `TimedSerializer.default_signer` is `TimestampSigner`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: TimedSerializer sets `default_signer: type[TimestampSigner] = TimestampSigner`.

items.claim: `Serializer.dump_payload` passes the serializer output through `want_bytes` to encode it to UTF-8.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `dump_payload` returns `want_bytes(self.serializer.dumps(...))`, and `want_bytes` encodes text as UTF-8.

items.claim: If `Serializer.loads` exhausts all candidate signers, it re-raises the last `BadSignature` rather than the first or an aggregate.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `last_exception` is overwritten each iteration and the final value is re-raised after the loop.

items.claim: `Signer` supports the key derivation methods `concat`, `django-concat`, `hmac`, and `none`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: derive_key handles 'concat', 'django-concat', 'hmac', and 'none' key derivations.

items.claim: `_CompactJSON.loads('{"id":5,"name":"itsdangerous"}')` returns `{'id': 5, 'name': 'itsdangerous'}`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `_CompactJSON.loads` simply delegates to `json.loads`, which parses that JSON object into the equivalent dict.

items.claim: `tests/test_itsdangerous/test_serializer.py` defines fixtures named `serializer_factory`, `serializer`, and `value`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The test module defines fixtures serializer_factory, serializer, and value.

items.claim: The default value of the `salt` parameter in `Serializer.__init__` is `b"itsdangerous"`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The real `__init__` signature declares `salt: str | bytes | None = b"itsdangerous"`.

items.claim: The `secret_key` parameter accepts a list of keys for key rotation.
items.label: supported
items.reason: _make_keys_list accepts an iterable of keys and Signer/Serializer store them as secret_keys for rotation.

items.claim: The `URLSafeSerializer` constructor accepts parameters `secret_key`, `salt` (defaulting to `'auth'` in the example), `serializer`, `serializer_kwargs`, `signer`, `signer_kwargs`, and `fallback_signers`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `URLSafeSerializer` inherits `Serializer.__init__` with exactly those parameters, and the README example passes "auth" as the salt.

items.claim: The pre-commit workflow uses `pre-commit-ci/lite-action@v1.1.0`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The workflow uses pre-commit-ci/lite-action pinned to a SHA labelled v1.1.0.

items.claim: `Serializer.make_signer` returns `self.signer(self.secret_keys, salt=salt, **self.signer_kwargs)`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `make_signer` returns exactly `self.signer(self.secret_keys, salt=salt, **self.signer_kwargs)`.

items.claim: `Signer` uses `.` as the default separator between payload and signature.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The `sep` parameter defaults to b"." and sign() joins value and signature with it.

items.claim: `HMACAlgorithm` defines a `get_signature()` method.
items.label: supported
items.reason: HMACAlgorithm defines get_signature returning the HMAC digest.

items.claim: Passing `sep="-"` to `Signer.__init__` raises `ValueError` at construction time.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `-` is part of `_base64_alphabet`, so the constructor raises `ValueError` about the separator.

items.claim: `TimestampSigner.unsign` raises `SignatureExpired` with the message `f"Signature age {age} > {max_age} seconds"` when the age exceeds max_age.
items.label: supported
items.reason: SignatureExpired is raised with exactly that f-string message when age > max_age.

items.claim: `Signer.verify_signature` loops over `reversed(self.secret_keys)`, derives a key for each, and returns `True` on the first algorithm match, otherwise `False`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The loop over `reversed(self.secret_keys)` derives a key per secret and returns True on the first match, else False.

items.claim: The `pre-commit` dependency group contains `pre-commit` and `pre-commit-uv`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The pre-commit dependency group lists 'pre-commit' and 'pre-commit-uv'.

items.claim: `Signer.unsign` raises `BadSignature` with the message "No b'.' found in value" when the separator is absent.
items.label: supported
items.reason: It raises `BadSignature(f"No {self.sep!r} found in value")`, which renders as "No b'.' found in value" for the default separator.

items.claim: When `is_text_serializer` is `True`, `Serializer.load_payload` decodes the payload bytes to UTF-8 text before calling the serializer's `loads`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: When `is_text` is true, `payload.decode("utf-8")` is passed to the serializer's `loads`.

items.claim: `TimestampSigner` embeds the timestamp base64 encoded.
items.label: supported
items.reason: sign() base64-encodes the int timestamp and appends it to the value.

items.claim: `Signer` has a `secret_keys` attribute of type `list[bytes]`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Signer.__init__ assigns `self.secret_keys: list[bytes] = _make_keys_list(secret_key)`.

items.claim: The pyproject.toml Changes URL is 'https://itsdangerous.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/'.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The Changes URL matches exactly.

items.claim: `_CompactJSON` in _json.py defaults `separators` to `(",", ":")` and `ensure_ascii` to `False`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `dumps` sets defaults `ensure_ascii=False` and `separators=(",", ":")`.

items.claim: `Signer.verify_signature` recomputes the signature rather than storing an expected signature.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `verify_signature` computes `self.get_signature(key, value)` on the fly and compares with `hmac.compare_digest`.

items.claim: The tests workflow's typing job sets `python-version-file: pyproject.toml`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The typing job's setup-python step uses python-version-file: pyproject.toml.

items.claim: `Signer` provides `sign()`, `unsign()`, and `validate()` methods.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Signer defines sign, unsign, and validate methods.

items.claim: `Serializer.make_signer` substitutes `self.salt` when the `salt` argument is `None`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `make_signer` replaces a `None` salt with `self.salt` before instantiating the signer.

items.claim: `docs/conf.py` enables the extensions `sphinx.ext.autodoc`, `sphinx.ext.extlinks`, `sphinx.ext.intersphinx`, `sphinxcontrib.log_cabinet`, and `pallets_sphinx_themes`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The extensions list contains exactly those five entries.

items.claim: The `secret_key` parameter of `Signer` is required.
items.label: supported
items.reason: secret_key is the first positional parameter with no default, so it is required.

items.claim: `SigningAlgorithm` is a generic base class in signer.py that can be subclassed to verify other signature schemes.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `SigningAlgorithm` is an abstract base whose `get_signature` raises `NotImplementedError` and is subclassed (e.g. `_ReverseAlgorithm`) for other schemes.

items.claim: The project declares `requires-python = ">=3.10"` in pyproject.toml.
items.label: supported
items.reason: pyproject.toml declares requires-python = ">=3.10".

items.claim: `.readthedocs.yaml` installs `uv` via `asdf`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The commands add the asdf uv plugin and install uv via asdf.

items.claim: `Signer.__init__` calls `_make_keys_list` on the secret key argument.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `self.secret_keys = _make_keys_list(secret_key)` is called in `Signer.__init__`.

items.claim: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` enables the hooks `ruff` and `ruff-format`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The ruff-pre-commit repo enables the 'ruff' and 'ruff-format' hooks.

items.claim: `URLSafeSerializerMixin.load_payload` delegates to `super().load_payload(json)`, the base `Serializer.load_payload`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The mixin ends with `return super().load_payload(json, *args, **kwargs)`, reaching `Serializer.load_payload`.

items.claim: When `signer_kwargs=None` is passed, `Serializer.__init__` sets it to `{}`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `self.signer_kwargs: dict[str, t.Any] = signer_kwargs or {}` yields an empty dict for None.

items.claim: `URLSafeSerializer` combines `URLSafeSerializerMixin` with the `Serializer` class.
items.label: supported
items.reason: URLSafeSerializer inherits from URLSafeSerializerMixin and Serializer[str].

items.claim: `SigningAlgorithm.verify_signature` is a base-class method inherited by `HMACAlgorithm` and returns `hmac.compare_digest(sig, self.get_signature(key, value))`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `HMACAlgorithm` defines only `get_signature`, inheriting `verify_signature` which returns `hmac.compare_digest(sig, self.get_signature(key, value))`.

items.claim: The URL-safe base64 alphabet used is `A-Za-z0-9-_`, excluding `+` and `/`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Encoding uses `base64.urlsafe_b64encode` and the alphabet constant is letters, digits and `-_=`, i.e. no `+` or `/`.

items.claim: `Serializer.loads` iterates `self.iter_unsigners(salt)` and returns `self.load_payload(signer.unsign(s))` inside a try block.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `loads` iterates `self.iter_unsigners(salt)` and returns `self.load_payload(signer.unsign(s))` within a try/except BadSignature.

items.claim: `Signer.default_key_derivation` is the string `"django-concat"`, used when `key_derivation` is `None`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `default_key_derivation = "django-concat"` and it is assigned when `key_derivation is None`.

items.claim: `Serializer.__init__` calls `is_text_serializer(serializer)`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `self.is_text_serializer: bool = is_text_serializer(serializer)` is executed in `__init__`.
